title: ResearchFinding
description: The memory record. Durable knowledge distilled from evidence, with full lineage back to the experiment that produced it (Law 3). Project-local forever in V1 (ADR-001).

finding_id.description: Unique, immutable identity of this knowledge record.

project_id.description: Owner project. Findings never leave this scope in V1 (Law 4).

experiment_id.description: The experiment whose evidence produced this finding. Law 3: no claim without lineage.

kind.description: What kind of knowledge this is. Failures are first-class kinds, not errors (principle 8.12).

statement.description: The knowledge in one self-contained sentence, understandable without reading the experiment. E.g. 'Raising model.learning_rate above 0.05 degraded correlation on all 3 trials.'

config_snapshot.description: Relevant config at time of finding.

data_ref.description: Dataset identity, if findings are data-dependent.

conditions.description: Scope of validity — under what conditions this knowledge holds. Enables ADR-004 rejuvenation: when conditions change, refuted findings may be re-tested.

metrics.description: Quantitative summary copied from evidence. Copied, not referenced, so memory stays queryable without artifact storage.

confidence.description: KAV's confidence in this finding. Single-trial findings start low; confirmations raise it.

tags.description: Free-form retrieval tags (parameter names, strategy names). Powers top-k context selection (ADR-004 Q1).

superseded_by.description: finding_id of a newer finding that replaces this one. Findings are never deleted — only superseded (immutability).
